title: Clear the two doctrine residuals the retired stage left behind
action: Per E7, two live files still describe a workflow stage that no longer exists -- both are the previous feature's own acceptance criterion (D11) left unmet, because that criterion was run as a manual sweep once and never again. (1) skills/bee-xia/references/research-brief-template.md around :54 reads 'Open questions (for the user, or as proof obligations for bee-validating):' -- route proof obligations to bee-planning's shape gate instead. This is a template an agent fills out today, so the wording must read naturally in the filled-out artifact, not as a find-and-replace scar. (2) packages/bee/hooks/test_write_guard.mjs around :664 still hand-builds the retired phase value for its apply_patch gate-policy rows. It is green only because the write-guard hook's own readState transparently coerces the legacy value before checkWrite sees it -- so the test currently proves the right thing for the wrong reason, and would keep passing if the coercion were removed. Migrate the fixture to a phase the state machine can actually produce. Do NOT delete the coercion; it is a locked decision from the prior feature. Never hand-edit a rendered skill mirror.

truths: No live file outside docs/decisions and docs/history routes work to the retired stage
The write-guard fixture uses a phase the state machine can produce
The xia template reads naturally when filled out

artifacts.substantive: proof obligations routed to the surviving gate

prohibitions: No removal of the legacy phase coercion
